doc: Hand-derived from res.gd, not measured (README.md). Three 64x64 cells drawn only after the arm at fixture frame 12: TEX (a post-arm Sprite2D drawing a pre-arm ImageTexture), PPM (a pre-arm GPUParticles2D + ParticleProcessMaterial, detached until frame 15), ITEM (a pre-arm Node2D whose _draw draws a plain rect, detached until frame 15). The capture must adopt the pre-arm texture (G8r), the pre-arm process material (PM7) and the two pre-arm items (LATE-RES node_added) at their first post-arm reference, leaving no unknown item RIDs (residue 0) and no refused resource.
